newsitem.title: THAILAND: Trade suspension on most Thai banks, finance lifted.
newsitem.headline: Trade suspension on most Thai banks, finance lifted.

text.p: The Thai stock exchange said on Tuesday that it would allow trading in suspended banks and finance stocks to resume from this morning's session.
Only the stocks of International Trust and Finance Plc, Sri Dhana finance and Dynamic Eastern Finance and Trust would remain suspended, it added in a statement.
The bourse said in a statement that the stocks of Finance One Plc and Thai Danu Bank Plc would also remain suspended while further details about their planned merger announced on Monday was awaited.

The suspension of trading in all banks and finance counters was done early on Monday ahead of a news conference by the central bank and the finance ministry to announce measures to shore up the troubled finance sector.

The stock exchange said it decided to lift the suspension order as the Bank of Thailand had announced measures to shore up the finance sector on Monday and investors were fully appraised of the steps to be taken.

On the three suspended stocks, ITF, Sri Dhana Finance and Dynamic Eastern, the bourse said it was awaitinggfurther information from them about their plans to increase capital in compliance with a central bank order issued on Monday.
The central bank had asked the three, along with seven others, to immediately raise their capital and told banks and finance firms to boost provisions against bad loans.
